name: design-fence
description: design-fence: a process for building software with AI agents, enforced by git and, in the session, by the agent tools' hooks.

plugins.name: design-fence
plugins.description: design-fence in the session, out of the agent's reach: refuses skipping the git hooks, asks the human before design-fence's own files change, holds the design-tool screenshot budget and the figma/ scripts to their command, and brings the rules back after a compaction. Does nothing in a project without design-fence.
